verified_facts.text: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia is located right on the beach of Santo Tomas in Menorca.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located right on the beach of Santo Tomás, Villa Le Blanc Gran Meliá stands as the first grand luxury hotel in Menorca.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has direct access to Santo Tomas beach from its garden.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits within the Cami de Cavalls route.

verified_facts.text: At the Thai Room Spa, native Thai therapists offer massages and treatments from Thailand.
